description: This file provides SIMD support for LDPC coding, including templates and functions to work with SIMD registers (AVX2, AVX512, NEON). It defines a simd_span class to handle spans of SIMD registers and related constants.

classes.name: simd_span
classes.description: A template class that mimics a span of SIMD registers, providing methods to access and manipulate SIMD data within a specified range.

methods.name: set_at
methods.description: Sets the SIMD register at a specified position to a given value (overloaded for different SIMD types).

methods.name: get_at
methods.description: Retrieves the value stored in the SIMD register at a specified position (overloaded for different SIMD types).
